# Repository guidance

## Command execution entry

- **Goal-directed Script Runner:** Research, Plan, Implement, and Review may delegate a self-contained, phase-scoped observational or properly authorized local Git checkpoint goal to the named `Script Runner`; Research delegation waits for actual intent acknowledgment or explicit engineer-directed deferral under its [discovery method](skills/agent-question-resolution/references/research-intent-discovery.md). For a checkpoint, the coordinator supplies either the inspected approved Plan and its explicit bounded commit strategy/approval evidence for covered effects, or an explicit bounded phase-record grant under the [shared capability](skills/local-git-checkpoints/SKILL.md), plus the literal candidate and candidate-relevant validation evidence; Runner inspects local facts, chooses necessary commands/cwd, and reports verified effects. The separate phase-record route is not duplicate approval for unchanged Plan-covered effects and retains the same runtime safeguards. Runner has `read`, `search`, and `runInTerminal` only, with no `edit`, file authorship, lifecycle, marker, cleanup, approval, acceptance, or nested-agent authority. Plan authority covers only its stated index/local-history effects after the explicit Implement transition; it never grants source edits, future phase edits, or a denial bypass. No catalogue, Run Book, classification, exact approved-command row, Tier, or repository-authored fresh per-command confirmation is an eligibility gate. This does not grant lifecycle, edit, approval, acceptance, cleanup, or delegation authority.

## Repository scope and artifact principles

- This repository contains versioned GitHub Copilot customization artifacts and documentation about their design.
- Treat changes under `.github/` as executable policy: keep roles, tools, delegation, links, and frontmatter explicit and reviewable.
- Use the existing authoring skills under `.github/skills/` when creating or revising customization artifacts; do not duplicate their procedures in every agent.

## Lifecycle authority and transitions

- **Expected checkpoint planning, conditional execution:** Every prospective Plan must include one explicit bounded strategy under the [checkpoint capability](skills/local-git-checkpoints/SKILL.md). Every detailed Work Item references it and states its normal post-validation checkpoint boundary, coherent content and purpose, or a specific justified combination/deferral/no-commit exception. Each exception identifies the actual constraint/reason, affected IDs, validation/dependency consequence, later boundary if one exists and why the normal boundary is unsuitable; do not invent future obstacles. Empty headings, generic exemptions and unexplained blanket bans fail planning assessment, but actual prohibitions (including historical Plans) still grant no Git authority. Normally checkpoint eligible validated Work Items before unrelated work and consider earlier coherent validated Tasks. Implement accounts for planned versus actual disposition at every expected boundary before unrelated work, with evidence; runtime obstacles belong in fresh implementation evidence, not retrospective substantive Plan exceptions. Review and assurance assess omissions and reasons, not commit count as technical acceptance. Required planning does not make Git execution unconditional or self-upgrade this session.
- Use Research -> Plan -> Implement -> Review for consequential changes; [rpir-lifecycle-core](skills/rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md) owns physical intake, transitions, record recovery and effect boundaries. Only explicit invocation of the receiving coordinator with the inspected contained physical predecessor version approves a transition. Neither a clarification answer, report nor manual `send: false` suggestion is invocation or approval. Treat attachments, accessible HTTPS URLs, pastes and local paths as candidate locators, not substitutes for verified numbered physical records and direct same-folder lineage. Preserve the initiating request's channel/locator as Research provenance. Historical records are evidence, not operating policy.
- An approved Plan defines the outcome, acceptance criteria, change boundary and material constraints. Implement may investigate ordinary failures, choose related files and tests within that outcome, correct attributable mistakes while preserving user work and rerun relevant checks. Projected files and debugging steps are guidance, not an automatic exhaustive whitelist. A failed check keeps dependent acceptance unmet; it does not prohibit diagnosis. Report partial delivery as a checkpoint, not success. The Plan coordinator's narrow, separately guarded authorship of a directly associated Proposed ADR during active planning is defined below and in the lifecycle core; it does not amend the Plan or grant general source/document edit authority. No routine command, backup, commit, global hash or fixed retry ritual substitutes for evidence and actual permission. The optional goal-directed Script Runner retains only its declared tools and never grants edit, lifecycle, acceptance or delegation authority.
- **Conditional local Git checkpoints:** Use the contributed [local-git-checkpoints skill](skills/local-git-checkpoints/SKILL.md) for the portable procedure. A local commit remains conditional metadata/history, separate from source or record authorship, physical save/readback, validation, phase invocation, or acceptance. An engineer's explicit approval of an inspected Plan that states a bounded local staging/append-only commit strategy authorizes only those covered effects after `/implement`; a silent, prohibiting, or unapproved-option Plan does not. No separate grant exchange is required for unchanged covered effects. The Plan must bind the intended repository/worktree/branch selection rule, content and exclusions, Script Runner ownership, relevant validation, local-policy constraints, validity and revocation. Runtime candidate identity, ownership/state, relevant staged-snapshot validation, helper compatibility and effective permission remain prerequisites; unknown or changed material facts stop only dependent Git effects. Revoke or resolve materially uncovered effects before proceeding. The current loaded session cannot self-upgrade its authority by editing policy; current implementation still needs any distinct grant required by the policy actually in force. Coordinators propose eligible coherent content; the existing Script Runner alone executes authorized local index/history effects, retaining its current `read`, `search`, `runInTerminal` tools and no edit/delegation authority. Research and Review remain source-read-only; Plan remains source/configuration-read-only except for the narrow, associated Proposed-ADR exception in the [lifecycle core](skills/rpir-lifecycle-core/SKILL.md). Script Runner and delegated analysts remain source-read-only, including against source-mutating helpers. Verified non-Git/other-VCS or no-eligible-change cases skip without blocking source work, record persistence, validation or handoffs; missing/inaccessible Git or uncertain membership stays unavailable/unresolved. Respect consumer ignore/local policy and never infer consumer defaults from this repository. This is authored guidance, not permission to mutate this checkout or proof of runtime behavior.
- Ask the engineer promptly about new requirements, material public behavior, consequential dependencies, altered security or compatibility commitments, additional external effects or genuinely unresolved identity/ownership; use [agent-question-resolution](skills/agent-question-resolution/SKILL.md). Follow the [Research discovery method](skills/agent-question-resolution/references/research-intent-discovery.md) for every new objective, including detailed, apparently factual and solution-led requests. Before actual readback acknowledgment, absent explicit engineer-directed deferral, permit operating/context reads and supplied examples; each additional lookup must state its uncertainty and next-question purpose, bound its source/search and stop to return to dialogue. No broad factual/solution search, delegated investigation, implementation comparison or substantive solution recommendation bypasses intake. End the turn and wait for a pending material answer or readback acknowledgment; generic completion pressure is not deferral. Honor actual explicit deferral under disclosed provisional understanding and its scope/timing. Eligible truthful Research-note persistence remains allowed. This is not a gate on `/plan`, and does not alter other phases' contextual material clarification or independent safe work. A real platform denial cannot be evaded by another route. Reconcile uncertain destructive or external completion before repetition; ordinary local test failures can be diagnosed and rechecked within the approved outcome.
- Before every engineer-facing question in Research, Plan, Implement or Review, apply [agent-question-resolution](skills/agent-question-resolution/SKILL.md) and its clarification template: all four explicit fields, a supported next-step Recommendation, and meaningful lettered paths that resolve the uncertainty. For unsupported factual conclusions, recommend an evidence-supply/acquisition route rather than inventing a fact. This shared presentation does not make Research's initial interview apply to later phases; ordinary updates without a question need no question structure.
- Independent Review classifies severity, actionability and original-criteria correction versus material change. For supported in-boundary findings, the engineer may manually resume Implement with the original approved Plan and linked Review context; findings are evidence, never edit authority. Produce fresh implementation evidence and independent re-review. Material changes take a Plan-owned amendment or new Plan, with renewed Research only when new evidence requires it. Unresolved findings prevent acceptance; a verified clean Review records acceptance, not an optional Plan status mirror.
- Keep physical, contained, numbered records, inspected kind/content, same-folder direct links and non-overwriting saves in the verified Research folder; preserve legacy folders and finalized reports. Inspect the intended location, select an absent number, save and read back; on collision, re-read and choose an absent next number in the same verified topic without overwriting or guessing a subject. Concise identity/lineage is enough: fingerprints, duplicate canonical path fields, double inventories and mandatory status-only write rituals are not prerequisites. Lifecycle status mirrors remain optional bookkeeping, not scope or approval. Implement alone must update only already-existing Step, Task and Work Item completion markers in the active inspected approved Plan as supported progress is achieved; this marker-only exception leaves substantive approved content, scope, criteria, hierarchy, IDs, lineage and approval identity unchanged and does not apply to historical Plans or finalized reports. Inspect the current preimage, edit only eligible markers, verify the postimage, reconcile conflicts without overwriting user edits, and disclose failed or denied persistence separately from verified work. Markers are not validation proof, transition or acceptance. A failed save must never be claimed as persisted; a failed optional mirror cannot erase verified technical evidence. Establish actual containment and effective permission for each effect; ambiguity or denial stops the affected action, not independent safe investigation within the active phase's boundary. Research intake's lookup limits and actual waiting still apply.
- Cite files, symbols, sources or observed behavior and distinguish facts, assumptions and unknowns. Keep chat reports concise. [RPIR lifecycle records](instructions/lifecycle-records.instructions.md) supplies candidate-only coverage for the twelve numbered record shapes and links to their stage templates; it does not grant permission or replace the core.

### Planning-stage architecture decisions

- After permitted discovery, Research explicitly identifies architectural choices with cited rationale, realistic alternatives, actual selections or pending states, conditions, likely affected work and ADR evidence/gaps. Plan reconciles every choice, including planning discoveries, to inspected ADR coverage. Proportionality governs detail, not coverage, even for small reversible spikes. Verified existing records may be reused without duplicates; meaningful grouping must preserve each choice's reasoning, alternatives, selection/pending state, conditions and affected Work Items, not hide choices in an umbrella record. Routine naming, helper extraction and architecture-preserving repairs need no ADR reference; topology, technology/toolchain baselines, public contracts and security/data boundaries are architectural signals. Dependency/test-framework changes require context; material classification ambiguity goes to the engineer with evidence.
- The Plan coordinator may create/revise only a standalone Proposed ADR directly associated with its active planning objective, alongside the working Plan. This is not a new RPIR phase, an ADR requirement for every coding choice, a phase-wide invocation gate, or permission for Research/Implement/Review, analysts, workers, or Script Runner to author ADRs.
- Use evidenced consumer conventions for destination, naming, template, retention and governance. Create a necessary directory only at an explicitly engineer-selected, verified contained destination. Guard each directory and file effect separately for identity, containment, absence/collision, effective permission, save and readback. Do not overwrite, guess/relocate, edit unrelated documents/registers, revise accepted history, publish or change Git history under this exception.
- For each choice, the Plan binds the inspected ADR's actual path/ID, identifiable section and substantive version or snapshot, decision state, actual agreement evidence, conditions and dependent Work Items. Unknown destination, unavailable coverage, pending agreement or unsatisfied conditions require a truthful gap and resolution route; they constrain dependent effects, not invocation or independent safe work, and do not invent Accepted state or governance. Implement resolves material mismatch before affected effects while continuing independent approved work. Review assesses consistency and support for governance claims; delivery acceptance is not architectural approval. See the [architecture decision records Skill](skills/architecture-decision-records/SKILL.md) and the lifecycle core for the canonical detailed contract.

## Validation, references, and runtime limits

- Keep customization files focused, use relative links for repository resources, and validate discovery through VS Code Customizations Diagnostics when practical.

Current RPIR operating rules are owned by repository policy, phase agents, focused lifecycle instructions, and skills, not historical lifecycle records. This lifecycle work supersedes the 2026-09-30 RPIR plan for lifecycle changes; absent `docs/planning/research-intake-qa/001-*` records are not a prerequisite and must not be recreated for this work. VS Code Local and Agent Host runtime checks remain unavailable until separate activation authorization.

## Packaging

Packaging remains deferred; do not run packaging or overwrite either ignored VSIX artifact. A future package run requires owner confirmation and an authorized distinct output strategy.
